verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an official MCP server and in-app AI assistant that let AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) 'answer questions and complete tasks' and use natural language to draft plans/pricing, which supports natural-language operation. However, this is scoped to specific tools/entities (MCP tool catalog, pricing-page drafting) rather than full natural-language control of the entire product, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence validating real-world reliability. Missing for 10: broad-coverage evidence that natural-language commands can drive most/all core workflows, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
